Summary: On March 18, 2026, the Federal Reserve decided to maintain the interest rate steady, projecting one rate cut in 2026 and one in 2027, and revised its inflation forecast to 2.7%. The decision was made in an 11-1 vote, with one dissent in favor of a rate cut.
